standard_prerequisites.name: Self-adjoint spectral operators, weighted simplicial links and conditional expectations
standard_prerequisites.use: All local weighted identities, the one-level argument and dimensional iteration are retained. Original attribution to Oppenheim and exposition from Dikstein remain intact.

core_obligations: The author exposition transfers local weighted-link spectra to the global adjacency spectrum by decomposing a global eigenvector into local constant and orthogonal parts, then iterates the fractional spectral bound across links. The general arbitrary-complex descent obligation is distinct from the previously counted concrete elementary-matrix coset construction.
